_synthetic_note: SYNTHETIC — fee-history-only fixture per ADR-005. No live archive-node RPC token in this sandbox, so field VALUES are fabricated but protocol-faithful to the archive-node wire format: EIP-1559-era block numbers (16200000..16200009, well past the London fork at 12,965,000), base fees ~9e9-1.3e10 wei with one 20x spike block (240e9 wei), hex-encoded JSON-RPC quantities. eth_feeHistory with empty percentiles returns oldestBlock/baseFeePerGas/gasUsedRatio only — no reward array (archive nodes reject percentiles; ADR-005 §Problem.1). Timestamps are always fetched from chain via batched eth_getBlockByNumber — they are NOT in this fixture.
